description: A small toy kitchen setup is in front, with a gray fridge cabinet beside an oven, and assorted plastic fruit visible inside once the door opens. The right hand reaches up to the fridge handle and swings the door open toward the viewer; then the right hand repeatedly reaches into the upper shelf to grasp and pull out a banana, a green fruit, a bunch of grapes, a yellow fruit, and finally a red apple, placing each onto the tabletop to the right while the left hand stays low and steady near the door area.
